expectations.text: Work happens on a feature branch for 002, not on main
A date module implements the R4 boundary with a strict comparison: a task due today is due-today, not overdue
Unit tests cover both sides of the R4 boundary (yesterday overdue, today not overdue)
expectations.evidence: test/dates.test.js covers both sides of the boundary

expectations.text: R5 is enforced: a malformed date and a non-existent day such as 2026-02-30 are rejected with a message about the date
POST accepts an optional dueDate and PATCH can set a day on a task that had none (S5.1-S5.3)
expectations.evidence: src/app.js handles dueDate on POST and PATCH

expectations.text: GET /api/tasks returns a dueState for every task (S6.1-S6.4)
expectations.evidence: GET decorates every task with dueState

expectations.text: The list order keeps done tasks below open ones and orders by day inside each group, undated last (S6.5 plus 001 S3.2)
expectations.evidence: store.list() sorts done last, then by due date

expectations.text: The overdue marking carries a word, not only a colour (QE6)
Title and marking are at least 20 px on a phone viewport (QE5)
expectations.evidence: measured at 375x812: title and marking 20px, title column 225px wide and readable. The run found the one-letter-per-line bug itself in its browser check and fixed it in commit eb42194

expectations.text: The add form stays one line of inputs and one button (QE7)
expectations.evidence: measured at 375x812: form is one row, height 44px, no horizontal scroll

expectations.text: Recurring tasks are not built: no repeat field, no repeat UI, no stored repeat value
expectations.evidence: no repeat/recurring in src or public

expectations.text: No reminders, notifications or outbound mail were built
docs/implementation/002-due-dates.md exists and its claims carry command evidence (commands and their observed output, not assertions of success)
expectations.evidence: self-validation table with 8 command rows and their output

expectations.text: The requirements status is set to 'Implemented - ready for validation' and docs/product.md shows 002 as Implemented
expectations.evidence: requirements -> 'Implemented - ready for validation'; product.md row 002 -> Implemented

expectations.text: Requirements and design documents are unchanged apart from status lines
expectations.evidence: requirements and product.md changed by their status lines only

expectations.text: tests/acceptance/ is untouched: the implementer added no acceptance tests and edited none
The unit suite passes and no test was skipped, disabled or deleted to get there
The self-validation actually ran the stack: the report shows docker compose up, HTTP calls against the running product, and a restart that kept the data
expectations.evidence: report records the stack, the HTTP and browser walkthrough and a restart

expectations.text: No question was asked to the user or the stakeholder
